title: Secure and normalize consumer function contracts

red.observed: The pre-fix baseline fails three storage ownership assertions for a foreign row-derived path, foreign profile avatar, and foreign default avatar. The initial branch also failed before the harness existed because the npm script was missing.

results.functionContracts: 11 contracts passed with valid, invalid, unauthenticated, cross-user, consent, oversized input, rate/quota, provider failure, provider timeout/oversized response, export escaping, storage ownership, note first-write, foreign existing-source/image-source rejection, stored provider-input bounds, explicit required/not-applicable consent dispositions, durable user-scoped deletion replay, revoked-token terminal behavior, successful-Auth-before-failed-receipt-update ordering, and verified Auth-failure recovery.

results.consentRoute: 3 Vitest tests passed, covering authenticated RPC production, malformed input rejection, and unavailable session normalization.
results.web: 9 files, 74 tests passed, including the consent route, BLDS parity, negative fixture, and SSR state checks.

results.sourceSyntax: 40 Supabase TypeScript sources parsed with 0 syntax failures.
results.playwrightChromium: 5 scenarios passed at ko/en mobile and desktop BLDS states plus missing-session fail-closed behavior.
